ultrarare_1_4.evidence_status: prospective preregistered heldout species-layer evidence in the same geographic system

rare_5_12.evidence_status: prospective preregistered species-layer non-replication in the same geographic system

near_ubiquitous_broad.status: terminal not estimable before heldout access

revised_ecological_synthesis.core: occupied-source information changes qualitative role across species occupancy regimes
revised_ecological_synthesis.ultrarare: for species present on only 1-4 pilot islands, source-network information is a prospectively supported realized-presence opportunity signal and is specific to the actual island adjacency relative to matched rewired nulls
revised_ecological_synthesis.rare: for species present on 5-12 pilot islands, the earlier overall source-network gain does not replicate and actual topology is not distinguishable from matched nulls
revised_ecological_synthesis.higher_occupancy: for the exploratory >=13-presence layer, natural-prevalence improvement is dominated by absence prediction, but post-hoc actual-vs-rewired analysis shows that this gain is not specific to the observed adjacency
revised_ecological_synthesis.broad_end: near-ubiquitous saturation could not be prospectively tested because no species met the frozen broad-layer gate
revised_ecological_synthesis.conservation_readout: connectivity should not be treated as one invariant property of an island; in the ultrarare layer, the spatial arrangement of the few remaining occupied source islands contains presence information, whereas at higher occupancy the predictive role changes or loses actual-topology specificity

cross_system_evidence.A_Islands_original_and_strong_reference: supports reference-conditioned structural adequacy, not universal topology benefit
cross_system_evidence.Tanzania: strong-reference generic structural increment adverse under LOSO and uncertain under spatial blocking
cross_system_evidence.historical_318_mammals: source information descriptively useful but extreme-isolation amplification unsupported
cross_system_evidence.GIFT_endpoint_subset: strongly selected nonconfirmatory descriptive concordance only

analysis_state.next_scientific_event: independent response-sealed system testing occupancy-regime-specific source-network roles, not further same-dataset threshold mining
